## Scope / 范围

- [ ] This PR contains one capability or safety boundary. / 本 PR 只包含一个能力或安全边界。
- [ ] Raw evidence and generated run artifacts are stored outside product Git. / 原始证据与生成的运行产物存放在产品 Git 之外。

## Change summary / 变更摘要

Describe the user-visible or engineering boundary and any beta incompatibility.
请说明用户可感知的变化或工程边界，以及任何 Beta 不兼容影响。

## Evidence layers / 证据层级

Record each layer separately. Do not treat one layer as proof of another.
请逐层独立记录，不要用某一层代替另一层证据。

- Tests / 测试：
- Commit / 本地提交：
- Push / 远端推送：
- Draft PR / 草稿 PR：
- Review / 审查：
- Merge / 合并：
- Release / 发布：

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass. / 相关自动化测试已通过。
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` describes the change in Chinese and English. / `CHANGELOG.md` 已用中英文记录本次变更。
- [ ] API, configuration, data, and workspace compatibility risks were checked where applicable. / 如适用，已检查 API、配置、数据与工作区兼容风险。
- [ ] User-facing copy is bilingual and shared behavior was checked in Writing and Game modes where applicable. / 如适用，用户文案为双语，且共享行为已同时检查写作与游戏模式。
